segments.text: ANd it fortuned, aſſoone as the Angels were gone awaye from the ſhepeheardes into heauen, they ſayde one to another: let vs goe nowe euen vnto Bethleem, and ſee thys thyng that wee heare ſay is happened, which the lord hath ſhewed vnto vs. And they came with haſte, and founde Marye and Ioſeph, and the Babe laide in a maunger. And when they had ſene it, they publiſhed abroade the ſaying whiche was tolde them of that childe. And all they that heard it wondered at thoſe thinges whiche were tolde them of the ſhepeheardes. But Mary kepte all thoſe ſayinges, and pondered them in her heart. And the ſhepheardes returned, praiſing and lauding God, for all the thynges that they had hearde and ſeene, euen as it was tolde vnto them. And when the eyght daye was come that the childe ſhoulde be circumciſed, hys name was called Ieſus, whiche was named of the Angell before he was conceiued in the woumbe.
